items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I was wondering again about the carnival balls that you played, say, with Sidney Desveen or any other group. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they have one or two, and we play a different type of music...

ctx.x: No, it's not the question of it's better, but it's the question of you're not seeing them. Yeah, something new.

New attraction, yeah. Something new, that's the question. Because over the rest of the country, usually for the last 50 years, they always thought the New Orleans bands were up to bed. That's right. Funny they'd have to bring in a band, but like you say, something new. Something new, that's right. I was wondering again about the carnival balls that you played, say, with Sidney Desveen or any other group. Did they play any special music, any different numbers? Just like a regular dance, I mean, did they have any…

Yeah, they have one or two, and we play a different type of music, play something like soft, sweet music, you know, for those things. Like they would put on a little float show. If they wouldn't have that, they would have a fashion show or something like that. Yeah, I think we do that. Say, well, we play a lot of the sweet music, sweet numbers for the fashion shows, things like that. Well, after, maybe that might last about an hour. Or maybe an hour and a half. Well, after that, the band would go back to…
